source_review.notes: Checked all twelve references for identity, authorship, date, edition, issuing body or venue, and relevant scope. Official ISO records support 42010:2022 and 42030:2019; ISO confirmed 42030 in 2025 and records a revision under development. Current official records support SEI ATAM, GSN Community Standard version 3, NIST SP 800-160 Volume 1 Revision 1, the NASA Systems Engineering Handbook, Google SRE production-readiness material, and the ACM Code of Ethics. Publisher, DOI, and institution records support the argumentation, judgment, modularity, and protection references. Domain processes are calibrations and are not represented as universal mandates, certification, or approval.
